At oscillator resonance E_h scalar and a two-vector determinant yields the exact weighted covariance determinant. The sharp quadratic eigenvalue expansion follows by uniformly summable first/second derivative expansions and geometric weighted variance. The continuous invariant covariance is positive definite by direct Lyapunov substitution, hence TV=1 at numerical rank collapse. value.rationale: The complete support classification is a natural design diagnostic for Brownian subinterval quadrature in stochastic exponential integration. It proves a minimum of two independent noise kicks for all-step full support, precisely locates infinitely many rational-split failures, quantifies their quadratic conditioning deterioration with a positive explicit coefficient, and identifies a maximal total-variation failure despite stable mean dynamics and correct small-step consistency. This is more than restating controllability, although it is restricted to the planar scalar-driven oscillator and exact arithmetic.
